name: chrome-export
description: Convert Chrome's bookmarks and history to HTML bookmarks files

repo.name: chrome-export
repo.description: Python scripts to convert Google Chrome’s bookmarks and history to the standard HTML-ish bookmarks file format.

readme.summary: Clear and well-organized README that covers the basics well but lacks concrete examples, configuration details, and troubleshooting guidance.
readme.top_issue: No examples of actual output or common usage patterns (e.g., exporting to a specific file, automating via cron), and no guidance on troubleshooting common issues like locked history files or missing default paths.

common_complaints: Cross-browser compatibility issues (Brave, Chromium, Google Chrome)
Poor default UX (requires arguments, unhelpful error messages)
praise_themes: Tool useful for bookmark migration workflows
sentiment.summary: Project shows signs of abandonment with a 14-year-old unresolved feature request still open, recurring bookmark loss issues across 2011-2023, and no visible resolution or maintainer engagement in recent issues.
